notes.design_intent: Passenger charters are ordinary transport work generated from passenger roles and reusable flavour descriptions.

board_split.terminal: More formal bookings: ordinary travellers, groups, companies, institutions and scheduled travel.
board_split.bar: Informal bookings: opportunistic travel, cash offers, stranded travellers and socially sourced work.

notes.role_generation: A description with an empty roles list can be used with any compatible civilian passenger role; otherwise its roles constrain generation.
notes.economy: Pay multipliers distinguish passenger markets without requiring bespoke mission logic.
